Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 10 kVA Online UPS 1. Scope of Work The scope shall include supply, installation, testing and commissioning of a 10 kVA True Online Double Con version UPS along with a compatible battery bank, battery rack/cabinet, interconnecting cables, accessorie s and all components required for complete operation. 2. Technical Specifications • Capacity: 10 kVA, minimum. • Technology: True Online Double Conversion. • Input: Three Phase, 300 V - 450V. • Output: Single Phase, 230V±1%. • Output waveform: Pure sine wave. • Output power factor: Minimum 0.9. • Input power factor: Minimum 0.99. • Display: LCD/LED display for input/output voltage, frequency, load, battery status and alarms. • Protection: Overload, short circuit, over-temperature, battery overcharge and deep-discharge protection. • Bypass: Automatic and manual bypass facility. • Battery: Compatible SMF VRLA or equivalent maintenance-free battery bank. • Backup time: Minimum 90 minutes at full load, or as specified in the tender schedule. • Standards: Relevant IEC/EN 62040 series or equivalent applicable Indian standards. • Bidder shall submit the detailed technical datasheet and point-by-point compliance statement. 3. Mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting Attendance at the pre-bid meeting organized by the concerned department shall be mandatory for all parti cipating bidders. Failure to attend shall result in disqualification from the tender process. 4. Mandatory Product Demonstration All participating bidders shall demonstrate the offered 10 kVA Online UPS before the concerned departmen t, as specified in the tender. The demonstration shall establish the offered product’s functionality and com pliance with the required specifications. Failure to provide the mandatory demonstration shall result in dis qualification. 5. Quality, Environmental and Product Certifications The bidder/OEM shall submit valid and verifiable copies of the following certificates/documents for the offered UPS, wherever applicable:

• ISO 9001 – Quality Management System certification. • ISO 14001 – Environmental Management System certification (the user-specified “ISO 4001” is commonl y referred to as ISO 14001; please verify the intended standard before tender publication). • CE conformity documentation for the offered model. • RoHS compliance declaration/certificate for the offered model. • All certificates shall be valid on the bid submission date and issued by an accredited/recognized certifica tion body or competent authority, as applicable. 6. Authorized Service Centre Network in Bihar The bidder/OEM shall submit a current list of authorized service centres located in Bihar, clearly mentionin g the centre name, full address, district, contact person, telephone number and email address. The list sha ll be supported by valid OEM authorization or other verifiable documentary evidence. The bidder shall ens ure availability of trained service personnel and spare parts support for the offered UPS within Bihar. 7. Eligibility and OEM Authorization The bidder shall be an authorized supplier, dealer or OEM of the offered UPS and shall submit valid OEM au thorization wherever applicable. The bidder shall possess the technical capability and service support requi red to execute the order. 8. Documents to be Submitted • OEM authorization certificate, wherever applicable. • Technical datasheet/catalogue and point-by-point compliance statement. • Valid ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certificates, as applicable. • CE and RoHS documents for the offered model. • Authorized service centre list in Bihar with supporting evidence. • Warranty confirmation, country of origin and local content declaration, wherever applicable. 9. Delivery, Installation and Commissioning The complete system shall be delivered, installed and commissioned at the designated department locatio n within 30 days from the date of purchase order, unless otherwise specified. Installation shall include all s tandard accessories, interconnections, configuration and operational checks. 10. Warranty The complete UPS system, including batteries and accessories, shall carry a minimum three-year compreh ensive onsite warranty from successful installation and commissioning, unless otherwise specified in the t ender. Warranty shall cover repair/replacement, labour and service charges. 11. Service Support and Response The supplier shall provide onsite technical support during the warranty period. Complaints shall be acknow ledged and attended within 24 hours, with resolution within a reasonable period. The bidder shall provide s ervice contact and escalation details. 12. Inspection and Acceptance The department reserves the right to inspect and verify the supplied equipment. Final acceptance shall be subject to successful installation, commissioning, demonstration of performance and submission of require d documents. 13. Payment Terms Payment shall be released after successful delivery, installation, commissioning, inspection and submissio n of the invoice and supporting documents, in accordance with applicable departmental and GeM payment rules.

14. Penalty for Delay In case of delay attributable to the supplier, liquidated damages shall apply as per the tender conditions a nd applicable GeM provisions. 15. Disqualification The department reserves the right to reject a bid that is technically non-compliant, contains incomplete or false information, or fails to meet mandatory tender requirements, subject to applicable procurement rules . 16. General Conditions All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GT C), bid conditions and relevant Government of India procurement rules. In case of conflict, applicable GeM provisions and tender conditions shall prevail. Technical Specifications 10 KVA Online UPS System - 3 In - 1 Out wit h 90 Min Backup Sl. No Parameter Specifications 1 SCOPE OF WORK S.I.T.C of 10.0 KVA IGBT based True Online UPS with Inbuilt Isolation Transformer with 3 Phase AC Input & 1 Phase AC Output ( External Isolation would not be accepted ) 2 Rating of UPS 10.0 KVA 3 Input Voltage 3 Phase : 350 - 450 Volt A.C ( UPS Should work on Mains irrespective of the Sequence of the Input Mains ) 4 Output Voltage 1 Phase : 230 Volt AC + 1 % 5 D.C Bus of UPS 360 Volt D.C 6 Battery Type S.M.F - V.R.L.A Type : Exide / Quanta 7 Backup Time 90 Min using 30 No's S.M.F Batteries of suitable Ah. 8 Battery Rack To be provided with the U.P.S along with Interlink Cable Set 9 Switching Device I.G.B.T 10 Input Frequency 50 Hz + 10% ( Should Work on Generator Supply ) 11 Output Frequency 50 Hz + 0.05 Hz ( Crystal Controlled ) 12 Waveform Harmonic Free Pure Sinewave 13 Transfer Time Nill 14 Power Factor 0.80 lagging to unity 15 Overload 110 % for 10 Minutes 16 Bypass Manual Bypass to be provided for maintenance purpose 17 LCD Display LCD Display to be provided which shall display UPS Status, Input & Output AC Voltage, Bat tery DC Voltage, Load Percentage & Charging Current 18 Protections AC & DC Shortcircuit protection & Battery Deeep discharge protections to be provided 19 Operating Temperature 0 to 50 defree Centigrade 20 Relative Humidity upto 85 % Non condensing 21 Warranty U.P.S Unit : 2 Years Comprehensive .
